text: A slider-crank uses a connecting rod to exchange rotary motion and reciprocating linear motion. The same geometry can drive a piston or be driven by one.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: Robert L. Williams II, Ohio University, ME 3011 Kinematics and Dynamics of Machines notes; https://people.ohio.edu/williams/html/PDF/NotesBook3011.pdf. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: A slider-crank reaches dead centers at the ends of piston travel. A flywheel helps carry rotation through positions where the piston cannot produce useful turning torque.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: Robert L. Williams II, Ohio University, ME 3011 Kinematics and Dynamics of Machines notes; https://people.ohio.edu/williams/html/PDF/NotesBook3011.pdf. Consulted 2026-10-13.
